## Slate overview
There are two ALDS Game 2s today. White Sox at Guardians is at 5:00 PM ET on TBS, with Chicago up 1-0. Yankees at Rays is at 8:00 PM ET on TBS, with Tampa Bay up 1-0 ([True Blue LA](https://www.truebluela.com/los-angeles-dodgers-schedule/126169/mlb-playoff-schedule-alds-game-2)). Our MLB record is 1-0 after yesterday's Brewers win.

## Best bets

### Yankees moneyline (-128) at Rays - 1 unit
- **Win probability 60% vs. 56.1% implied.**
- **Big pitching edge.** Cam Schlittler had a 1.95 ERA, 0.92 WHIP and 239 strikeouts over 193 2/3 innings, and his 1.16 road ERA was the best in the majors ([Bettors Insider](https://bettorsinsider.com/mlb/2026/10/05/yankees-vs-rays-alds-game-2-prediction-cam-schlittler-looks-to-even-the-series-at-tropicana-field/)).
- Freddy Peralta has only 10 starts for Tampa Bay (3.25 ERA, 1.01 WHIP). He was very good in September (0.92 ERA), but it's a small sample ([Athlon](https://athlonsports.com/mlb/tampa-bay-rays/rays-freddy-peralta-game-2-alds-yankees)).
- Down 1-0, New York is starting its best pitcher, and the price (-126 to -131) doesn't fully reflect the gap between the starters. Fair price is about -150. Playable to -140.

## Leans & passes
- **Guardians -163 vs. White Sox:** pass. Gavin Williams (3.76 ERA, 248 K, 2nd in MLB) faces a Chicago bullpen game opened by Anthony Kay. Kay has a 4.44 ERA overall but a 1.27 ERA in 21 1/3 innings against Cleveland this year ([SI](https://www.si.com/betting/white-sox-vs-guardians-prediction-odds-probable-pitchers-prop-bets-for-alds-game-2-2026), [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/articles/mlb/white-sox-stick-with-bullpen-plan-anthony-kay-to-open-al-division-series-game-2-vs-guardians)). At -163 the Cleveland favorite has no edge.
- **Under 6.5 (+100) in Cleveland:** lean. A high-strikeout starter against a Chicago staff that has handled Cleveland, but we couldn't verify enough to bet it.

## Risks
- Playoff bullpens get used aggressively, so a short Schlittler start puts the game on New York's relievers.
- Prices came from search snippets. Confirm before betting.
